notes.title: Hell Runner Spring Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome To Spring Chapter
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251580/465060ea3791b7b8d399fc10330bf338681be98b.png[/img]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Chapter: Spring
[*] New Skill: Dash: Launch you in the direction you moving horizontally and reset jump count
[*] Adjusted Hookshot maximum distance: The maximum distance you can aim to start a Hookshot has been reduced by half. 
[*] Levels that use the Hookshot have been adjusted accordingly to the new Hookshot range
[*] Stomp changed. Now it works as toggle. Click to activate and click to deactivate earlier. 
[*] Wall Run modified. Now you have more horizontal movement and less vertical movement. 
[*] Wall Jump have kick in it. Push you toward opposite direction slighly
[*] Jumpers have directional push now. Stomp also increase directional power of jumpers
[*] Level selection lock image fixed
[*] Ledge detection improved
[/list]

[h1]Demo Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Demo has been updated and now it have 2 level from spring as well alongside getting other updates.
[/list]
